## Fig. S1

S1)  Effects of growing tomato with motherwort on tomato root dry weight.

```{r S1}
library(DescTools)
library(Rmisc)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
Data_FigS1<- read_excel("../data/Source Data Supplementary Fig1,3,6.xlsx",sheet = "Supplementary Fig1")
Data_FigS1$group <- factor(Data_FigS1$group,levels = c("CK","Ca","Gf","Bg","Ce","Ps","Rfs","Pl","Mt"))
SE<-summarySE(data = Data_FigS1,measurevar = "dry weight",groupvars = "group")

dunnett <- DunnettTest(x = Data_FigS1$`dry weight`, g = Data_FigS1$group, control = "CK")
p_values <- dunnett[[1]][, "pval"]
p_data <- data.frame(group = sub("-CK$", "", names(p_values)),p = as.numeric(p_values))
p_data$group <- factor(p_data$group, levels = levels(Data_FigS1$group))
p_data$label <- paste0("P = ", ifelse(p_data$p < 0.001,format(p_data$p, digits = 2, scientific = TRUE),format(round(p_data$p, 4), trim = TRUE, scientific = FALSE)))
p_data$y <- 0.43
p_data <- p_data[c(2,4,6:8), ]

FigS1 <- ggplot()+
  geom_rect(aes(ymin=summary(Data_FigS1[97:108,]$`dry weight`)[1],ymax=summary(Data_FigS1[97:108,]$`dry weight`)[6],xmin=-Inf,xmax=Inf),fill="gray",alpha=0.5)+
  geom_errorbar(data=SE[-1,],aes(x=group,ymin=`dry weight`-se, ymax=`dry weight`+se,color=group),width=0,position=position_dodge(0),linewidth=0.45)+
  geom_point(data=SE[-1,],aes(x=group,y=`dry weight`,color=group,fill=group),shape=21,size=1,stroke=0.6)+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#5a5a58","#5a5a58","#5a5a58","#5a5a58","#5a5a58","#5a5a58","#5a5a58","#3d89a3"))+
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("white","white","white","white","white","white","white","#3d89a3"))+
  geom_text(data = p_data, aes(x = group, y = y, label = label),
          angle = 90, size = 2.5, color = "black") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0.4, 0.44))+
  labs(x='',y='Underground\ndry weight (g)')+
  theme_classic2()+
  theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 7,color="black"),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 7,color="black"),
        axis.ticks = element_line(size=0.25),
        axis.ticks.length = unit(0.05, "cm"),
        axis.line = element_line(size=0.25),
        legend.position = "none")
ggsave(file.path(output_dir, "FigS1.pdf"), FigS1, width = 4, height = 3)
FigS1
```


## Fig. S2

S2)  Shannon diversity index of rhizosphere microbial communities under different treatments.

```{r S2}
library(LorMe)
library(ggplot2)
library(Rmisc)
library(agricolae)
library(ggpubr)
asv <- read.csv("../data/ASV_table.csv")
design <- read.csv("../data/design.csv")

alltax_summary <- tax_summary(groupfile = design, inputtable = asv[, 2:37], reads = TRUE, taxonomytable = asv[, c(1, 38)], outputtax = "standard")
innocu_tax_summary <- object_config(taxobj = alltax_summary, treat_location = 2, facet_location = 3, rep_location = 4)

alpha_frame=Alpha_diversity_calculator(taxobj =innocu_tax_summary,taxlevel = "Base" )
shannon<-subset(alpha_frame$alphaframe,Indexname=='Shannon')
shannon$Group<-rep(c('Mo.To','Mo.To+','Co.To','Co.To+','Co.Mt','Co.Mt+'), each = 6)
shannon$Group<-factor(shannon$Group,levels = c('Mo.To','Co.To','Co.Mt','Mo.To+','Co.To+','Co.Mt+'))

shannon$x <- rep(c(1,4+1,2,5+1,3,6+1),each=6)
SE<-summarySE(data = shannon,measurevar = "Indexvalue",groupvars = c("x","RS"))

anova_result <- aov(Indexvalue ~ Group, data = shannon)
tukey_result <- HSD.test(anova_result, "Group")
tukey_labels <- tukey_result$groups
tukey_labels$name <- rownames(tukey_labels)
tukey_labels$name <- c(5+1,6+1,3,4+1,1,2)

FigS2 <- ggplot(data=shannon,aes(x=x,y=Indexvalue))+
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "bar", width = 0.7, aes(group=factor(x)),fill="white",color="black",linewidth=0.3) +
  geom_point(position = position_jitter(width = 0.25,height = 0),aes(shape = group,color=RS),fill=c('white'),size = 2,stroke = 0.1,alpha=0.6) +
  geom_errorbar(data=SE,aes(ymin=Indexvalue-se, ymax=Indexvalue+se),width=0.2,position=position_dodge(0),alpha=0.8,linewidth=0.3)+
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(4.2, 5.6))+
  geom_text(data = tukey_labels,aes(x=name,y=5.5,label = groups),size=2.4)+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#4aac44","#ff8c00"))+
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(1, 2, 3, 5, 6, 7),
                     labels = c('Mo.To', 'Co.To', 'Co.Mt', 'Mo.To', 'Co.To', 'Co.Mt')) +
  labs(x='',y='Shannon')+
  theme_classic2()+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 7,color="black",angle=25,hjust=1),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7,color="black"),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 7,color="black"),
        axis.ticks = element_line(size=0.25),
        axis.line = element_line(size=0.25),
        axis.ticks.length = unit(0.05, "cm"),
        legend.position = "none")
ggsave(file.path(output_dir, "FigS2.pdf"), FigS2, width = 4, height = 3)
FigS2
```


## Fig. S3

S3)  Suppressive effects of isolated Sphingomonas strains on R. solanacearum.

```{r S3}
library(ggplot2)
library(ggprism)
library(DescTools)
library(dplyr)

Data_FigS3<- read_excel("../data/Source Data Supplementary Fig1,3,6.xlsx",sheet = "Supplementary Fig3")
colnames(Data_FigS3) <- c("treatment", "abundance", "group")
Data_FigS3$group <- factor(Data_FigS3$group, levels = unique(Data_FigS3$group))

dunnett <- DunnettTest(x = Data_FigS3$abundance, g = Data_FigS3$group, control = "CK")
p_values <- dunnett[[1]][, "pval"]

p_data <- data.frame(group = sub("-CK$", "", names(p_values)), p = as.numeric(p_values))
p_data$group <- factor(p_data$group, levels = levels(Data_FigS3$group))
p_data$label <- paste0("P = ", ifelse(p_data$p < 0.001,
                                      format(p_data$p, digits = 2, scientific = TRUE),
                                      format(round(p_data$p, 4), trim = TRUE, scientific = FALSE)))
p_data$y <- Data_FigS3 %>% group_by(group) %>% summarise(y = max(abundance) + 0.04, .groups = "drop") %>% right_join(p_data, by = "group") %>% pull(y)

FigS3 <- ggplot(Data_FigS3, aes(x = group, y = abundance)) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.6, fill = "white", color = "black", linewidth = 0.35, outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_point(aes(color = group), position = position_jitter(width = 0.12, height = 0), size = 1.2, shape = 21, stroke = 0.5) +
  geom_text(data = p_data, aes(x = group, y = y, label = label), inherit.aes = FALSE, angle = 90, size = 2.5, hjust = 0) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#f44336", "#ff9800", "#ffc107", "#cddc39", "#00bcd4", "#00c853", "#00bcd4", "#e91e63", "#4caf50")) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(4.1, 5.05), clip = "off") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Ralstonia abundance (log10RFP)") +
  theme_classic2() +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 7, color = "black"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 35, hjust = 1),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 8, color = "black"),
        axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.25),
        axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.25),
        legend.position = "none")
ggsave(file.path(output_dir, "FigS3.pdf"), FigS3, width = 4, height = 3)
FigS3
```


## Fig. S4

S4)  Volcano plot showing differential rhizosphere metabolites between monocultured and co-cultivated tomato under R. solanacearum infection.

```{r S4}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

Mo.To.RS_Co.To.RS <- read.csv("Mo.To.RS_Co.To.RS.csv")

plot_data <- Mo.To.RS_Co.To.RS %>%
  mutate(type = case_when(
    fdr7 < 0.05 & fold1 < 0 ~ "Mo.To(RS+)",
    fdr7 < 0.05 & fold1 > 0 ~ "Co.To(RS+)",
    TRUE ~ "nosig"
  ))

plot_data$type <- factor(plot_data$type, levels = c("Mo.To(RS+)", "nosig", "Co.To(RS+)"))

n_left <- sum(plot_data$type == "Mo.To(RS+)", na.rm = TRUE)
n_right <- sum(plot_data$type == "Co.To(RS+)", na.rm = TRUE)

FigS4 <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = fold1, y = -log10(fdr7))) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = 2, color = "gray70", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = 2, color = "gray70", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_point(aes(color = type, size = ave1), alpha = 0.8, shape = 16) +
  annotate("text", x = -7, y = 10, label = paste0("Mo.To(RS+)\nn = ", n_left), color = "#FFBF00", size = 3, fontface = "bold") +
  annotate("text", x = 7, y = 10, label = paste0("Co.To(RS+)\nn = ", n_right), color = "#FF8C00", size = 3, fontface = "bold") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Mo.To(RS+)" = "#FFBF00", "nosig" = "#A9A9A9", "Co.To(RS+)" = "#FF8C00")) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(0.5, 3)) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-10, 10), ylim = c(0, 11)) +
  labs(x = expression(log[2]~"fold change"), y = expression(-log[10]~"(adjusted P-value)"),size="Relative\nabundance (%)") +
  theme_zg() +
  theme(
    axis.text = element_text(size = 7, color = "black"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 7, color = "black"),
    axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.25),
    axis.ticks.length = unit(0.05, "cm"),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.5),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 6),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 6),
    legend.key.size = unit(0.35, "cm"))

ggsave(file.path(output_dir, "FigS4.pdf"), FigS4, width = 5, height = 3)
FigS4
```


## Fig. S5

S5)  Impact of R. solanacearum infection on rhizosphere metabolite profiles in the tomato-motherwort co-cultivation system.

```{r S5}
library(ggplot2)
library(ggprism)
library(dplyr)
library(patchwork)

Co.To <- read.csv("Co.To.csv")
Co.Mt <- read.csv("Co.Mt.csv")

plot_volcano <- function(data, title, xlim) {

  data$type <- factor(data$type, levels = c("down", "nosig", "up"))
  n_down <- sum(data$type == "down", na.rm = TRUE)
  n_up <- sum(data$type == "up", na.rm = TRUE)

  ggplot(data, aes(x = fold1, y = -log10(fdr7))) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = 2, color = "gray75", linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = 2, color = "gray75", linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_point(aes(color = type, size = ave1), alpha = 0.55, shape = 16) +
    annotate("text", x = xlim[1] * 0.92, y = 10.2, label = paste0("RS-, n = ", n_down), color = "#4aac44", hjust = 0, size = 2.6, fontface = "bold") +
    annotate("text", x = xlim[2] * 0.92, y = 10.2, label = paste0("RS+, n = ", n_up), color = "#ff8c00", hjust = 1, size = 2.6, fontface = "bold") +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("down" = "#4aac44", "nosig" = "#A9A9A9", "up" = "#ff8c00")) +
    scale_size_continuous(name = "Relative\nabundance (%)", range = c(0.5, 3), breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 3)) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = xlim, ylim = c(0, 11)) +
    labs(title = title, x = expression(log[2]~"fold change"), y = expression(-log[10]~"(adjusted p-value)")) +
    theme_classic2() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold", hjust = 0),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 7, color = "black"),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 7, color = "black"),
      axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.25),
      axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.25),
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.4),
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.title = element_text(size = 6),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 6),
      legend.key.size = unit(0.35, "cm")
    ) +
    guides(color = "none", size = guide_legend(override.aes = list(color = "gray50", alpha = 1)))
}

# FigS5A
FigS5A <- plot_volcano(Co.To, "Co.To", c(-11, 11))
ggsave(file.path(output_dir, "FigS5A.pdf"), FigS5A, width = 4, height = 3)
FigS5A
# FigS5B
FigS5B <- plot_volcano(Co.Mt, "Co.Mt", c(-7, 7))
ggsave(file.path(output_dir, "FigS5B.pdf"), FigS5B, width = 4, height = 3)
FigS5B

#FigS5C
```

## Fig. S6

```{r S6}
library(ggplot2)

library(patchwork)

#FigS6A
Mo.Mt.RS_Co.Mt.RS <- read.csv("Mo.Mt.RS_Co.Mt.RS.csv")

plot_data$type <- factor(plot_data$type, levels = c("down", "nosig", "up"))

n_left <- sum(plot_data$type == "down", na.rm = TRUE)
n_right <- sum(plot_data$type == "up", na.rm = TRUE)

FigS6A <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = fold1, y = -log10(fdr7))) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = 2, color = "gray75", linewidth = 0.4) +

        axis.title = element_text(size = 7, color = "black"),
        axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.25),
        axis.ticks.length = unit(0.05, "cm"),
        panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.5),
        legend.position = "right",
        legend.title = element_text(size = 7),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 6),

ggsave(file.path(output_dir, "FigS6A.pdf"), FigS6A, width = 5, height = 3)
FigS6A



#FigS6B
Data_FigS6B <- read_excel("../data/Source Data Supplementary Fig1,3,6.xlsx", sheet = "Supplementary Fig6B")
Data_FigS6B$group <- factor(Data_FigS6B$group)

plot_S6B <- function(data, value, ylabel, ymax) {

  SE <- summarySE(data, measurevar = value, groupvars = "group")

  fit <- aov(reformulate("group", response = value), data = data)
  tukey <- HSD.test(fit, "group", group = TRUE)$groups
  tukey$name <- factor(rownames(tukey), levels = levels(data$group))

  ggplot(data, aes(x = group, y = .data[[value]])) +
    stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "bar", width = 0.6, linewidth = 0.3, color = "black", fill = "white") +
    geom_errorbar(data = SE, aes(ymin = .data[[value]]-se, ymax = .data[[value]]+se), width = 0.2, linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_point(aes(color = group), position = position_jitter(width = 0.2, height = 0), fill = "white", size = 0.7, shape = 21) +
    geom_text(data = tukey, aes(x = name, y = ymax*0.9, label = groups), inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 2.4) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("#bebebe", "#c1d6e0", "#83afc1", "#3d89a3")) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.03))) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, ymax)) +
    labs(x = "Palmitic acid (mM)", y = ylabel) +
    theme_classic2() +
    theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 6, color = "black"),
          axis.title = element_text(size = 7, color = "black"),
          axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.25),
          axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.25),
          axis.ticks.length = unit(0.05, "cm"),
          legend.position = "none")
}

# FigS6B1
FigS6B1 <- plot_S6B(Data_FigS6B, "Ralstonia abundence(OD600)",
                    expression(italic("Ralstonia")~"abundance (OD"[600]*")"), 1.2)

# FigS6B2
FigS6B2 <- plot_S6B(Data_FigS6B, "Sgm13 abundence(OD600)",
                    expression("SPH4 abundance (OD"[600]*")"), 1.1)

FigS6B <- FigS6B1 + FigS6B2
FigS6B
ggsave(file.path(output_dir, "FigS6B.pdf"), FigS6B, width = 5, height = 2.8)



#FigS6C

Data_FigS6C$group <- factor(Data_FigS6C$group)

# FigS6C1 
FigS6C1 <- plot_S6B(Data_FigS6C, "Ralstonia abundence(OD600)",
                    expression(italic("Ralstonia")~"abundance (OD"[600]*")"), 1.2)

# FigS6C2
FigS6C2 <- plot_S6B(Data_FigS6C, "Sgm13 abundence(OD600)",
                    expression("SPH4 abundance (OD"[600]*")"), 1.1)

FigS6C <- FigS6C2 + FigS6C2
FigS6C
ggsave(file.path(output_dir, "FigS6C.pdf"), FigS6C, width = 5, height = 2.8)
```
